import Part, Sketcher
doc=App.getDocument("hook_lesson3")
ss=doc.Spreadsheet; body=doc.Body
ss.set('A6','hole_d'); ss.set('B6','4 mm'); ss.setAlias('B6','hole_d')
ss.set('A7','hole_spacing'); ss.set('B7','30 mm'); ss.setAlias('B7','hole_spacing')
doc.recompute()
sk=body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject','HoleSketch')
sk.AttachmentSupport=[(doc.YZ_Plane,'')]; sk.MapMode='FlatFace'
sk.addGeometry(Part.Circle(App.Vector(-10,15,0),App.Vector(0,0,1),2),False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.Circle(App.Vector(-10,45,0),App.Vector(0,0,1),2),False)
c=[]
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Diameter',0,4.0)))
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Equal',0,1)))
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical',0,3,1,3)))
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY',0,3,1,3,30.0)))
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX',0,3,-1,1,10.0)))
c.append(sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY',-1,1,0,3,15.0)))
sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%c[0],'Spreadsheet.hole_d')
sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%c[3],'Spreadsheet.hole_spacing')
sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%c[4],'Spreadsheet.width / 2')
sk.setExpression('Constraints[%d]'%c[5],'(Spreadsheet.plate_height - Spreadsheet.hole_spacing) / 2')
doc.recompute()
pk=body.newObject('PartDesign::Pocket','Holes')
pk.Profile=sk; pk.Type=1  # ThroughAll
pk.Midplane=True
doc.recompute()
print(sk.solve(), [ (g.Center.x,g.Center.y,g.Radius) for g in sk.Geometry], pk.Shape.Volume, pk.isValid())
s=pk.Shape
for e in s.Edges:
    bb=e.BoundBox
    if abs(bb.ZMin-10)<1e-6 and abs(bb.ZMax-10)<1e-6: print('top edge',bb)
